author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See follow-up posts for details. Character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for now, with potential for more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM. Still receiving artist replies; author has not closed the request.

author: Allie Higdem
title: Need non-AI character art for a book
content: I need character art! Contact: reply on the thread or DM. Artists are still pitching; request not marked closed.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for posters and ad creatives
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, and simple visual adaptations/resizing. Prefer someone with a good eye for clean and modern design, who can follow brand guidelines/references, is responsive, meets deadlines, and is comfortable with ad and social media creatives. Follow-up: freelance/project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects. If interested, drop portfolio + rate in the comments or DM. Contact: comments or DM on Threads.
